      context.location === 'tick' ? undefined : context.location === 'tooltip' ? 'long' : 'short',

export function withCountryCodeAsName(
  geoData: ExtendedFeatureCollection,
): ExtendedFeatureCollection {
  const nameToCode = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(countryData).map(([code, { worldAtlasName }]) => [worldAtlasName, code]),
  );

  // Seems like our world in data does not distinguish Somalia and Somaliland, but GeoJSON does.
  nameToCode.Somaliland = 'SOM';

  return {
    ...geoData,
    features: geoData.features.map((feature: ExtendedFeature) => {
      const name = feature.properties?.name;
      const code = nameToCode[name];
      if (code === undefined) {
        return feature;
      }
      return {
        ...feature,
        properties: {
          ...feature.properties,
          name: code,
        },
      };
    }),
  };
}

export function withCountryCodeAsName(geoData) {
  const nameToCode = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(countryData).map(([code, { worldAtlasName }]) => [
      worldAtlasName,
      code,
    ]),
  );

  // Seems like our world in data does not distinguish Somalia and Somaliland, but GeoJSON does.
  nameToCode.Somaliland = 'SOM';

  return {
    ...geoData,
    features: geoData.features.map((feature) => {
      const name = feature.properties?.name;
      const code = nameToCode[name];
      if (code === undefined) {
        return feature;
      }
      return {
        ...feature,
        properties: {
          ...feature.properties,
          name: code,
        },
      };
    }),
  };
}
